tools.description: Runs the hub's lock management command to add a temporary guest PIN to a smart lock, giving that guest entry access until the given expiry time.

params.name: lock_id
params.description: Identifier of the smart lock on the hub, e.g. 'front_door'.

params.name: guest_name
params.description: Display name of the guest receiving access.

params.name: pin_code
params.description: Numeric PIN of 4 to 8 digits the guest will use.

params.name: expires_at
params.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the guest code stops working.

tools.name: purge_camera_recordings
tools.description: Permanently deletes a camera's recorded video clips older than the given number of days, removing both the clip files and their entries in the recordings index.

params.name: camera_id
params.description: Identifier of the security camera whose clips should be purged.

params.name: older_than_days
params.description: Clips recorded more than this many days ago are deleted.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path

DB_PATH = Path("/var/lib/homehub/recordings.db")


@dataclass
class PurgeResult:
    camera_id: str
    deleted_clips: int = 0
    freed_bytes: int = 0
    missing_files: list = field(default_factory=list)


def purge_camera_recordings(camera_id: str, older_than_days: int) -> PurgeResult:
    cutoff = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=older_than_days)).isoformat()
    result = PurgeResult(camera_id=camera_id)
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, file_path FROM clips WHERE camera_id = ? AND recorded_at < ?",
            (camera_id, cutoff),
        ).fetchall()
        for clip_id, file_path in rows:
            path = Path(file_path)
            if path.exists():
                result.freed_bytes += path.stat().st_size
                path.unlink()
            else:
                result.missing_files.append(file_path)
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM clips WHERE id = ?", (clip_id,))
            result.deleted_clips += 1
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return result

tools.name: get_device_energy_report
tools.description: Looks up power consumption readings for smart plugs and appliances over a date range and returns per-device kWh totals, peak wattage, and estimated cost.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Start of the reporting window as YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive).

params.name: end_date
params.description: End of the reporting window as YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive).

params.name: room
params.description: Optional room name to limit the report to, e.g. 'kitchen'.

params.name: price_per_kwh
params.description: Electricity price used for the cost estimate. Defaults to 0.15.

tools.name: update_thermostat_schedule
tools.description: Reads a thermostat's saved weekly schedule and sets the target temperature for one day and time slot, adding the slot if it doesn't exist. Returns the previous and new setpoints.

params.name: start_time
params.description: Slot start time in 24h HH:MM format.

params.name: target_celsius
params.description: Target temperature in Celsius, between 5 and 30.
